sources.locator: AutomationScheduler schedule, executeRun, catchUpOnWake and unschedule
sources.finding: node-cron schedules a Claude command in a new local worktree and terminal. A per-automation lock skips overlapping runs until PTY exit. Unschedule removes the cron job; it does not terminate an active PTY.
